policies.outbound:
<emit-metric name="TotalTokens" value="@{
            var body = context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
            var usage = body?["usageMetadata"] as JObject;
            var inTok  = (int?)usage?["promptTokenCount"]     ?? 0;
            var outTok = (int?)usage?["candidatesTokenCount"] ?? 0;
            return (double)(inTok + outTok);
        }" namespace="enterprise-ai-gateway">
